## Description

Provide a clear summary of the changes and the issue/feature they address. Link to relevant issues.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / code quality improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines.
- [ ] I have tested these changes locally by opening `index.html` in a browser.
- [ ] I have updated the README or documentation if necessary.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce external dependencies.
- [ ] I have checked for existing issues and PRs before submitting.
